name: @equin/plugin-code-explorer-file-kind
description: What a changed file is, from its repo path alone: fileKindOf(path) → code | test | doc | generated (tests by the test layout's isTestFilePath plus Go's _test.go, generated by codegen's GENERATED_ARTIFACTS, docs as *.md), and FILE_KINDS — the closed list with each kind's label and icon. Pure core, so a commit's file list classifies client-side with no wire change.
